icd.nota: ICD di riferimento dichiarato; la corsa lo rifissa

evidence.nota: Le osservazioni storiche sono state tolte: registravano esiti parziali di campagne su revisioni che non esistono piu' nel percorso corrente, e un'evidenza parziale conservata accanto a uno stato `not_satisfied` si legge come progresso. Restano recuperabili da git.

pass_conditions: All three revisions and the ICD revision are immutable and recorded.
Identity-preserving operations preserve every required property byte-for-byte.
Derived fields reconstruct metadata from the result and never inherit invalid source metadata.
A read boundary preserves conflicting representations and declares them in LossReport or FidelityAssessment.
The central component propagates conflicts unless an explicit plan resolves them.
A write boundary fails closed with four-axis error semantics before a permanent effect when a conflict remains.
Both required directions pass on Linux and Windows without an unreported LossReport entry.
The evidence bundle includes commands, environment, fixture hashes and results.
open_blockers: The database_to_data_to_io direction has not been executed.
Native Windows execution of the three-component chain is not covered.
The external runner does not yet consume read_loss and keeps the R4.6.1 declaration as an unverified obligation.
The external matrix evidence declares ICD v2.0-rc8 while the current component provenance records v2.0-rc14.
The recorded 83/84 and 27/28 qualification belongs to v1.0.0-rc.1; the matrix has not been rerun on the v1.0.0-rc.2 candidate.
components_nota: le revisioni sono `null` perche' la qualifica non e' stata eseguita: le fissa l'owner esterno al momento della corsa, e una revisione vecchia qui descriverebbe una campagna che non e' quella corrente
